style: Original 3D black comedy about pensions, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: white head feathers, glasses on a chain, big cobalt-blue vest. Hugs a HUGE shiny GOLD piggy bank, half his size, slot on its back, hole in its belly. Deadpan, never flies.
second_characters: ONE grinning mole boss, purple suit. THREE clerks, orange ties: white rabbit, ferret, beaver.
props: Piggy bank: goose's; its scarlet belly cork: mole's. Gold coins: from it into the mole's open cherry-red briefcase. Shovel: yellow handle, scarlet bow; mole's, then the goose's. Row of gold piggy banks on the mole's sill, each tied with an orange tie like the clerks'.
environment: Bright TURQUOISE glass tower, open 40th-floor window; pale lilac tile plaza, revolving glass door.
lighting: Noon sun; warm key on the goose's face, amber rim left, hot-pink rim right; gold and cobalt vivid on turquoise and lilac.

light_events.event: gold coins flash in the lens

motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice, lines exactly as written, beak free

timeline.a: From the first frame: gold coins gush into the lens from the piggy bank's belly hole; above, the goose dangles outside the 40th-floor window, wing in the mole's farewell handshake; the mole's free paw holds the pulled scarlet cork.
timeline.c: rises out of the briefcase to the handshake, close-up

timeline.a: The mole lets go and waves bye; the goose drops, piggy bank hugged, coins spraying from the slot.
timeline.c: whips down, waving paw in foreground

timeline.a: Falling, he snaps a flying coin in his beak, drops it back in the slot.
He hits the lilac tiles, sinks neck-deep, cracks ringing his neck.
The piggy bank cracks on his head into two empty gold halves; the last coin rolls away.
The rabbit grabs the coin, pats the goose's head with it, darts into the revolving door; ferret and beaver follow, looking back with pity.
timeline.c: threads the door, legs in foreground

timeline.a: With a wingtip he presses the empty halves together and hugs the mended piggy bank to his neck again.
timeline.c: circles low round the piggy bank

timeline.a: Up top the mole throws the bowed shovel down like a spear; the goose jerks his head up.
timeline.c: climbs the facade to the throw

timeline.a: At 7.90 the shovel skewers the mended piggy bank to the tiles a finger from his neck, halves bursting apart; he does not blink.
timeline.c: rides the blade down, hurls itself into his face, close-up

timeline.a: He hauls himself out of the hole by the handle, stands at attention, nods, beak free.
timeline.c: sweeps up the handle with him

timeline.a: At the window the mole pulls the cork from the next tied piggy bank's belly; coins pour into his briefcase. Last frame: gold flood, orange-tied piggy banks behind.
timeline.c: shoots up into the briefcase, close-up

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, muted colors, dark scene, night, food, vegetables, shopping bags, cats, humans, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood
